div.div:
Thermal
2.5-3.5 W dissipated; 13 × 8 mil vias under U1 EP to bottom copper; heatsink via 4 × M3 (H1, 1 in pattern); package base ≤ 85 °C; 60 min soak.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 698px; height: 1px; padding-top: 515px; margin-left: 207px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ededed); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Notes
• Levels: room temp, nominal EVB184 gain; hot gain ~1.1 dB lower (~27.6 dBm out).
• Pad is bench-adjustable: 3 dB 300/18, 5 dB 180/30, 6 dB 150/36 Ω.
• 5V_RF must stay ≤ 5.20 V (SSI derating of 5.25 V abs max) - River R21 change.
• Never enable without a 50 Ω load or antenna on J3.
